integrity: A complete analytic proof and a standalone exact-rational checker accompany the result. Computation corroborates but does not prove the infinite statement; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Canonical unweighted edge-indicator metric only, p and q at least 2; no result for other matroids, non-Euclidean gauges, or critical scaling c=1 at finite dimension; historical priority provisional.
title: Sharp Euclidean inball phases of complete-bipartite spanning-tree polytopes
